SEARCH
Package domain

Class Stadium

java.lang.Object
domain.Stadium
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Stadium extends Object implements Serializable
The field in one of the three resolutions, with a goal at each side. The goals are scaled to the size of the field.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

    • Stadium

      public Stadium(String resolution, String name) throws DOPOSoccerException
      Creates the field and its two goals.

      resolution - "SMALL", "MEDIUM" or "LARGE"

      Throws:
